claims.text: The model makes mistakes due to underspecified frames, leading to ambiguous interpretations of relationships between objects.
Metaphorical language can confuse the model, as it may misinterpret abstract meanings of verbs, resulting in nonsensical comparisons.
Frame and attribute similarity factors hinder the model's performance, causing incorrect predictions in certain contexts.
